admission.justification: All start routes exclude caller permission authority; the shared catalog validates ordinary least-mode or explicitly selected cross-scope host-default mode against known offers, while an unanswered mode part leaves a configured choice unchecked.

applicability: Every role start route that resolves a working mode.
conditions: With known mode offers, only an omitted cross-scope step-up mode takes the offered host default; ordinary fallback remains least working.
Unavailable mode answers use the saved successful part; without either answer a configured mode stays unchecked. A known unoffered named mode refuses before creation.
exclusions: Caller-supplied mode arguments or permission-bearing feature arguments, which no start route accepts.
statement: No start route accepts a caller mode or permission-bearing feature argument. With known mode offers, ordinary starts without an applicable authored mode use the least offered working mode, and an explicitly selected cross-provider/model step-up with omitted mode uses the offered host default. A known unoffered mode is refused; when neither a fresh nor saved mode answer exists, a configured mode passes to Paseo unchecked.
